title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetOperation
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetOperation. This class is the means of a set service to communicate in a procedure-type manner over the network (i.e. transmit data to/from other devices). It is the machine-interpretable exposure of a human-understandable Command to a network. Subclass of saref:Operation (core SAREF).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SetOperation'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasInput.description: Relationship (saref:hasInput, core SAREF). The COSEM-instance/property input of the set operation (a CosemOperationInput subtype, e.g. SetOperationDataInput, SetOperationObisInput or SetOperationObjectInput).
